title: Language
appLangNote: Used everywhere unless a part of the app or a page has its own language. The page reloads after a change.
sections: Language per part of the app
sectionsNote: A part can speak another language than the rest — for example Learning in German while everything else stays in English.
pageLangNote: Visitors see the page in this language. Without a choice, the page follows each visitor's language.
partLangNote: Without a choice, the part speaks the language of its page.
